title: nan
authors: Hong J.-H.; Ryoo C.-K.; Shin H.-S.; Tsourdos A.
key_contribution: Presents an integrated guidance, navigation, and control system for UAVs in GPS-denied environments using image and range sensors with backstepping control, verified by numerical simulation.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
